description: Three.js helps JavaScript draw 3D scenes in a browser. A scene holds objects, a camera chooses the view and a renderer draws the picture. Learn one cube before adding movement, light and cleanup. Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.
versionNote: Uses stable Three.js scene, camera, geometry, material and WebGLRenderer APIs.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the camera x position and compare the view
Learn to move the cube to x=-1
Learn to move the directional light to the other side
learningObjectives: Learn to change the camera x position and compare the view
Learn to move the cube to x=-1
Learn to move the directional light to the other side
